title: Out / Back
action: Hold for an excursion, release, see the sphere return.
material_fact: The random direction and distance vary within a program whose return remains compulsory.

evidence.claim: A seeded destination varies the excursion; the return and cycle are authored. Holding can carry the body; release lets the sphere finish alone.

primary.author: Samuel Beckett
primary.operation: Let the return recur until the rule becomes available through the action.

counterpoint.author: Jorge Luis Borges
counterpoint.operation: Distinguish permitted variation from altering the system that permits it.

refusal: Do not manufacture a paradox or a hidden authority.
Do not claim that choosing a new seed can remove compulsory return.
Do not prescribe exhaustion or helplessness as the participant's feeling.
